name: Jyotiprakash Mishra
roles: Assistant Professor of Computer Science, KIIT
tagline: I break and fix processors, and I build the tools I wish I had as a student.
summary: Computer scientist with sixteen years across enterprise software, healthcare technology, university teaching and hardware security research. My doctoral work at BITS Pilani is on the security of open RISC-V processors: microarchitectural side channels, memory encryption and hardware support for detecting malware. Before teaching I spent eight years in industry, as a Team Lead at Epic Systems in Madison and a Senior Member of Technical Staff at Oracle. I teach computer architecture, operating systems and programming at KIIT, and I build free, open teaching tools that show students what is really happening inside a machine.

experience.glance: An engineering company across RISC-V silicon, clinical healthcare software and security research.
points: Founded and lead an engineering company with three lines of work. The hardware arm designs custom silicon, RISC-V processors, FPGA prototypes and production-ready systems on chip, with a focus on open instruction sets and hardware security.
Healthcare software: clinical-grade systems including electronic health records, pharmacy management, laboratory information systems and patient-facing applications built for real medical workflows.
Security research consultancy: offensive security training, threat modelling, architecture reviews and support for academic research.
Develop and publish consumer software on the Google Play Store: utilities, emulators and learning apps.

points: Teach core computer science courses (computer architecture, operating systems and programming) to undergraduate and graduate students.
Conduct and publish research in hardware security, RISC-V, malware analysis and cryptography; present at international conferences.
Pursue research and industry funding; responsibility for examinations and faculty recruitment interviews.

points: Led the team developing specialty healthcare software for Epic's international customers.
